acceptance_criteria.details: New package with Drizzle client, migrations, exports

discoveries.discovery: DATABASE_URL must use absolute paths with file: prefix for SQLite
discoveries.context: Relative paths break in monorepo due to varying CWD
discoveries.lesson: Always use file:/absolute/path format for SQLite URLs

discoveries.discovery: drizzle.config.ts env loading varies by execution context
discoveries.context: Config loaded from different CWDs in monorepo
discoveries.lesson: Config should try multiple .env paths to support all contexts

what_worked: Drizzle ORM integrates well with libsql

new_patterns.name: WORKTREE_ENV_ISOLATION
new_patterns.description: Git worktrees need separate .env files with absolute DATABASE_URL paths

new_antipatterns.name: RELATIVE_DATABASE_URL
new_antipatterns.description: Using relative path without file: prefix in DATABASE_URL

new_antipatterns.name: DUAL_ENV_LOADING
new_antipatterns.description: drizzle.config.ts and packages/env load .env from different locations
